verdict.rationale: Bento's only in-product AI evidence is a homepage claim that its AI builds things from a plain-text description (bento-docs-10), which is generative assistance rather than insights drawn from your data. Data-driven AI analysis is only possible indirectly, by pointing an external AI assistant at the hosted MCP server to look up subscribers and events (bento-docs-5, bento-docs-53), and that happens outside the product. Missing for 10: any documented in-product AI insights or recommendations derived from subscriber, event, or revenue data; details of what the AI builder produces; independent or hands-on corroboration.
